scientific_scope: Reference-free engineering qualification of the already-frozen P3-v1 local-sector Weber steering mechanism. This policy is frozen before P3 runtime implementation and before any P3 simulation execution.

nominal_reachability_panel.purpose: Verify finite deterministic relative-sector steering, canonical biology-RNG isolation, structural invariances, and non-degenerate reference-free open-arena reachability without target outcomes.

required_structural_checks: For every exact-identity seed, zero-dose P3 is bit-exact to canonical ant state and biology RNG state with zero sector/steering evaluations.
For every exact-identity seed, kappa=0 P3 is bit-exact to canonical ant state and biology RNG state with zero sector/steering evaluations.
P3 adds zero RNG streams and zero biology RNG draws.
The deterministic sensor operator produces exactly 32 front-left and 32 front-right samples using the frozen 4x8 equal-area midpoint rule.
The pure relative transduction returns exactly zero for zero/equal signal, is left-right antisymmetric, and is positively scale invariant within frozen tolerance.
Endpoint reversal, rigid translation, and rigid rotation preserve local sector summaries and steering within frozen tolerance.
Left-right reflection swaps sector summaries and reverses steering sign with equal magnitude within frozen tolerance.
Centered parallel trail geometry away from endpoint effects yields equal sector summaries and zero steering within frozen tolerance.
Every nominal-panel trial completes without NaN/Infinity in ant state or P3 diagnostics.
At least one nominal-panel trial contains at least one P3 steering evaluation.
Mean moving speed and all open-arena summaries are descriptive diagnostics only and may not tune the mechanism.
implementation_constraints: P3 runtime must extend canonical integrity.Simulation directly.
P3 may reuse frozen P1 helpers for apparatus, field concentration, distance-to-segment, and moving-step preview only; it must not instantiate P1 or P2 Simulation as a base.
P3 runtime may implement only the frozen local-sector Weber steering mechanism.
No response RNG or p_lapse state is allowed.
No treatment-, path-, colony-, direction-, or experience-specific response parameter is allowed.
No speed, pause, angular-noise, contact, boundary, apparatus, observation, or scoring change is allowed.
No H2-H5 mechanism combination is allowed.
No canonical file may be modified.

result_rule.pass: All frozen structural checks pass on the exact panels. This establishes implementation/reachability only, not biological fit.
result_rule.fail: Fix implementation defects only. Do not change the P3 mechanism, sector geometry, engineering values, seeds, trial counts, dt, invariances, or pass checks in response to reachability outcomes.
